scripts.build: bun run check:drift && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && vite build
scripts.tauri:dev: bun run build:zsh-bin && bun run sync:extensions && bun run check:drift && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.check:drift: bun run check:extensions && bun run check:commands && bun run check:agent-bounds && bun run check:wm-bounds && bun run check:extension-orders
scripts.precommit: bun run lint && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path extensions/zsh-autosuggestions/native/Cargo.toml && bun run typecheck && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path extensions/zsh-autosuggestions/native/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && bun run check:drift && bun run test && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib && cargo test --manifest-path extensions/zsh-autosuggestions/native/Cargo.toml
